chat.t: So you are the famous Fixer.
I have heard much about you.
Would you be willing to share your wisdom with me?

o: Who is this?

chat.t: My name is Chise.
I am a wanderer who is still learning the ways of the world.
If it is not too much trouble, I would like to learn from you.

o: I'm busy, so I'll pass.
What was that?

chat.t: I was taught to do this when the other party refuses...
Is that not correct?

o: Ah...

chat.t: I've been thinking about what 'heat' means.
Looking back, when you touched my breast, it felt as though a spark was ignited in my heart.
Could this spark be what people mean by 'heat'?

o: Close. But not quite.

chat.t: Is that so...
Heat is indeed a difficult concept.

lines.t: Somewhere in Humanitas
Upon arriving at the meeting spot, my eyes met with a cold-looking woman.
Wait, why did it suddenly get so chilly?
It is a pleasure to meet you. My name is Chise.
I am currently traveling and training in various places to learn about the world.
And? Get straight to the point.
Please share with me the wisdom of how you escaped the Panoticon.
I didn't exactly escape using wisdom.
How did you escape then?
It just sort of happened.
I understand that feeling well.
When I train, my body moves on its own without me fully understanding why.
You're a genius!
You have nothing left to learn!
However, I am unsure if that is correct. I feel as though I am constantly going in circles.
I believed that you, having achieved the feat of escaping the Panoticon, might know the answer.
Sounds like you're lacking a drive in life.
A drive in life...?
The power to move forward, the power that heats up your chest.
Heats up my chest... I do not understand what kind of sensation that is.
What is heat?
I'll make you feel it right now!
(I boldly reach out my hand.)
As expected, I felt a pleasant elasticity and softness.
And then, this feeling that instantly rushed in...
Ah, so cold!
Ugh... I thought my hand was going to freeze. You're incredibly cold.
Ah, my apologies. I have a somewhat unusual constitution... I should have warned you in advance.
If it makes you uncomfortable, it might be best to keep some distance from me.
It's not uncomfortable, just fascinating. I've never felt this kind of cold before.
So, how is it? Did your chest get a little warmer?
I am not sure. For what reason did you grab me?
That is the very drive that burns in my chest.
Specifically, the drive to squeeze your chest.
Heat... drive... I think I am beginning to understand, albeit vaguely...
I have heard of the phrase, '<bouten>taking action before thinking</bouten>'.
Is that what you mean by "drive" and "heat"?
Move instead of wasting time thinking. Doesn't that sound thrilling just hearing it?
Then, the reason you went out of your way to grab my chest...?
Your chest is the best place to feel heat, after all.
...Indeed. So it was to make me feel the heat.
But with the intense cold you're giving off, you probably couldn't feel it properly.
You are correct.  I still... do not understand.
I’ll find something properly stimulating for you.
Stimulation... perhaps that is what I need the most...
Thank you. To think you would go to such lengths for me.
Is there perhaps anything I can do for you in return?
Alright. Then, why don't you think about heat on your own? Think of it as homework until we meet next time.
Understood. Thank you very much for today.
I will ponder deeply on the concept of heat until our next meeting.

chat.t: I have completed my homework.
Would you care to meet? Homework is usually graded in person, after all.

o: I just finished getting ready too.

chat.t: Understood. I will be waiting.

o: Maybe you can stop using those weird emoticons?

chat.t: I was taught to use these when I am feeling excited...
Is that not correct?
If not, my apologies...
I was taught to use these when offering my apologies.

o: Haah...

chat.t: Fixer, did you return home safely?
I have spent some time contemplating the words you left me with.
Thank you once again for allowing me to experience so much.

o: Think nothing of it.

chat.t: Could you wait just a little longer for the special place you asked about?

o: Sure. Take your time. I'm looking forward to finding out where it is.

chat.t: Thank you. I will not disappoint you.

lines.t: Somewhere in Humanitas
I am glad to see you again. Have you been well?
I have diligently completed my homework.
Good job. Then let me ask you. What do you think heat is?
Heat is...
Emerging from the breath exhaled by snowfields,
Falling as cold rain to become silent ice,
Only to clash with intense light and slowly melt away,
I believed the tears that flowed from ice were themselves a form of heat.
What do you think? I have attained enlightenment from the truths held within all creation.
I suppose it was a good idea to invite some <bouten>special guests</bouten> today after all.
One more! One more! One more! One more!Fit Angel A
Squat! Deadlift! Bench press!Fit Angel N
Chest! Back! Core!Fit Angel N
Are these people... the Fit Angels?
The ones said to value exercise above all else...
That's right. They're a very passionate and hot-blooded bunch.
They're also the guest instructors who will teach you about heat today. Come on, introduce yourselves.
Is it this member?Fit Angel A
Not, a member, yet, but, will, join, soon!Fit Angel N
Just how long has it been since we had a prospective member...Fit Angel A  Waaah...!
Is this the person who said she would get PT if she could ignite her fire?Fit Angel N
That's right. If you guys win, I'll sign her up as a new member.
Oooh! A new member!Fit Angel A
Time, to show, the results, of, our, hard work!Fit Angel A
Let's go...! We're getting...! A new member...!Fit Angel N
The time has come to show off the bodies we've built!Fit Angel N
So this is passion and heat...
Very well. I shall face you.
U-Ugh... It's incredibly cold... My muscles are freezing...Fit Angel A
Gasp!, Gasp!, what on earth, is this, it's not even, midwinter!Fit Angel N
No matter how fiercely a flame burns... it must eventually yield before the cold.
No... it was so close... if we train just a bit more... we can win...!Fit Angel A
Exactly! We are not ones to be broken by this!Fit Angel N
That cannot be. Your passion and heat did not reach me...
We were just one set short!Fit Angel A  Doing one more set will solve everything!
Yes, we, just, need to do, more!Fit Angel N
Right... ten more sets... no, a hundred more sets...!Fit Angel A
Exactly! We can win!Fit Angel N
Back to cardio running!Fit Angel A One more! One more!
They are fascinating people...
If it were me, I would have swallowed my frustration and tried to compose my emotions first.
But those two are already thinking about challenging it again immediately.
That is what heat is. It's the drive that makes you stand back up even when you fall.
I felt it clearly. I have never been that hot-blooded before.
If I were to learn to have such a heart, could I become stronger?
Of course. Just like... tempering.
Tempering... indeed. They do say a masterpiece blade is perfected through tempering.
I beg of you.
Could you please teach me the secret to feeling that kind of heat?
Well, if you're asking that much, I have no choice.
But there's a condition.
Yes. I will do whatever you ask.
Tell me where your special place is.
Yes, of course. However, nothing comes to mind right now.
It's fine. Tell me whenever you think of it.
Understood.

chat.t: {player}, my lord, are you well? I send you my warmest greetings.
I have also thought of my special place.
This very chat room—because it's where I can be with you.
This is the place I cherish most of all.

o: This place is special to me too.
But besides that, do you have a secret place only you know about?

chat.t: Ah, yes. The 'Thinking Forest.' It is a place filled with cold winds and stillness.
I often visit it to gather my thoughts and compose my mind.

o: Alright, let's meet there.

chat.t: Pardon? There is not much to see in that forest, and it is not a very exciting place...

o: It's fine. I'll head over right now.

chat.t: Fixer, did you return safely?
I wished to express my gratitude once more.
If there is anything you desire, please do not hesitate to tell me.

o: Then I want you to show me a stronger Chise.

chat.t: Ah...
Understood. I shall become stronger. I will grow stronger and wait for you!

lines.t: Thinking Forest
When I arrived at the forest, I saw Chise standing there.
It was cold enough for our breath to mist, but Chise didn't seem to mind at all.
Fixer, thank you for making the journey here. Are you not cold?
I felt uneasy knowing you were coming all this way to a place like this...
I'm fine. If anything, didn't you wait a long time?
To me, waiting is like an old friend.
Though today, my heart was a mess, tangled with anticipation and regret...
There's no need to feel sorry. If anything, I think I'm the one who'll end up feeling sorry today.
You? Why would that be?
Well, you'll see. Shall we walk for a bit? Lead the way, please.
Yes. I know this place well, so please leave it to me.
As we walked, it grew quieter. Just as Chise said, it was indeed a silent place.
I walked with my hands exposed to get used to the temperature Chise experienced.
Then, a thick, massive tree caught my eye. Yes, this spot would do nicely.
This spot should do.
Here... you mean? You have a keen eye. This is considered one of the finest spots.
But what are we to do here?
To teach you about heat, of course.
But you look so cold to be discussing heat here, Fixer...
I'm fine. If anything, I should be asking if you'll be okay.
I'm going to be strict with you from now on. So much so that you might even hate me.
That could never happen. I am ready.
You might feel humiliated, ashamed, or even resentful. Are you still okay with that?
Of course. I am not so fragile.
Good. Then... Grab your skirt and lift it up.
...Pardon?
Should we stop?
No, not at all. Understood. Here...
Like this, you mean?
*Smack!*
Ah...
No. Higher. Lift it more. Take this seriously.
A-Ah, understood. My apologies...
Haa... Haa...
Are you okay, Chise?
Yes... I am finally catching my breath.
It was an experience unlike any other...
How was your first taste of heat?
The heat... felt like a sweet release.
And it felt incredibly wonderful...
What should I do if I wish to experience this feeling again?
Be honest with yourself about what you want to do and feel, and devote yourself to it completely.
An honest mind... Indeed. I have often forced myself to suppress my emotions.
I believed that was the only way to maintain my coldness.
Right. The honesty to face your own emotions will become the driving force that leads you to become stronger.
Understood. I will keep that close to my heart.
Ah...
It seems the heat has not yet fully faded from me.
Don't worry. Lean on me. We'll take it slow.
Are you sure? If you let me lean on you, you might catch a chill...
I don't know about that. Right now, you actually feel incredibly warm. Here.
Ah, thank you...

chat.t: Fixer, have you been well?
I find myself daydreaming much more often these days.

o: Are you feeling sick or something?

chat.t: No. I am in good health.
It is just... that what happened in the forest keeps coming back to me.
Has something gone strange with me?

o: Not at all. That's just how warmth behaves.

chat.t: Then... what should I do...?

o: Just show me how much stronger Chise has become. I'll visit you soon.

chat.t: I have already finished my preparations.
I will be waiting, praying for your swift... no, safe arrival.
Fixer, I am so sorry. I am so sorry...
I got so carried away that I failed to consider you, Fixer.
I am sorry... I am so sorry...
I am sorry...

lines.t: Somewhere in Humanitas
Fixer.
Was your journey difficult? I am sorry for causing you unnecessary trouble...
...Sorry, Chise. It's nice holding hands, but...
I'm going to freeze.
Ah! Forgive me... I was simply so overjoyed to see you...
I grew arrogant thinking I understood heat, yet I remain as cold as ever.
I am deeply ashamed...
No, it's fine. I was just a little surprised.
It is solely due to my inexperience... I still do not fully comprehend heat.
Two more! Two more! Two more! Two more!Fit Angel H
Two more! Two more! Two more! Two more!Fit Angel A
Power Squat! Power Lift! Power Press!Fit Angel A
Lats! Pecs! Spinal erectors!Fit Angel N
Ah, they arrived earlier than I expected.
These people... they are the ones I sparred with last time...
Is this the place? Where that clueless girl is?Fit Angel H
H-Head Trainer! No, she's a prospective member! A prospective member!Fit Angel A
We have returned! And we've come back stronger!Fit Angel N
She still looks as clueless and uptight as ever!Fit Angel N
Why have you all returned?
I've heard all about you. You said you'd only take personal training from someone stronger than yourself?Fit Angel H
This time, as the Team Leader, I will face you myself.Fit Angel H
What do you say to another test?Fit Angel H
Your burning passion was made clear to me back then.
Thanks to you, my eyes have been opened. If anything, I am the one who is grateful.
However, I cannot allow my time with the Fixer to go to waste.
Chise, this is a great opportunity to show me your progress.
But...
Let the fire inside you burn even brighter!
Where is the heat you felt before?
Pardon? It still remains within me...
How did you feel it in the first place?
By responding in sync with you, Fixer... Ah...
Ah, I see.
Heat is something we build together. When someone shows their passion, we must meet it with everything we have.
If one ignores the warmth of others, they can never truly become hot themselves.
Exactly. Avoiding this battle means turning away from the heat.
Understood. I will clash with them once more.
So you've changed your mind.Fit Angel H Good!  Let's get to it! Angels!
Two more! Two more! Two more! Two more!
I, too, shall face you with all my might...!
Now...! Here I come...!
Kh...Fit Angel H Just as they said... You are strong...!
Angels! Squeeze out every drop of strength! Show her our final set!Fit Angel H Now, one more set!
One more set! One more set! One more set! One more set!
I can certainly feel much more warmth than last time.
But now, I too have learned what heat is.
I shall take all of your heat and show you my own!
O chill bestowed by the moonlight, before this coldness fades, I shall cleave all asunder!
Ice... Burst!
What is this unbelievable chill...!? Everyone, look out!!Fit Angel H
Aaaagh!!Fit Angel A
...Ugh!
Ah... Oh no...!
Fixer? Fixer!
Fixer!!

Caught in the immense blast of cold that Chise unleashed,
I ended up losing consciousness...

chat.t: Please contact me when you awaken.
I shall rush to your side immediately...

o: Chise? Ah, I must have lost consciousness for a moment.
I'm in some kind of bathhouse right now... Do you know where this is?
Well, you seem busy, so you can reply later.
For now, I guess I'll just warm up here.

chat.t: Fixer, did you greet the morning well?
My body feels remarkably light today. I wonder if it is thanks to last night...
My hands are a bit numb, however. It must be because I held on so tightly yesterday.
Do you feel sore or uncomfortable anywhere, Fixer?

o: Hmm... My lower back is a little stiff.

chat.t: Ah...
It is because I pushed you too hard, Fixer.
Why not soak in the waters once more? It should cure you completely.

o: I'd love to, if you'll have me.

chat.t: Understood. In that case, I shall always be waiting for you.

lines.t: I looked around. It was an unfamiliar hot spring.
I couldn't remember how I ended up here.

Did Chise move me here?
But she wouldn't have laid a hand on my body so easily...
Anyway, since there's a bath here, I might as well use it. Let's start by lightly dipping my feet in.
Ouch! Hot!

I screamed the moment it touched my feet. At this temperature,
they're not trying to bathe me, they're trying to boil me alive.
Fixer!
Are you awake?
Ugh... Chise, you're too close.
Oh... My apologies.
I have caused you harm, Fixer. That is why I was reflecting on my actions alone...
However, upon seeing the MochiTalk message you sent, I rushed over immediately.
Are you alright? Do you feel any discomfort anywhere?
Yeah, I'm okay. But that was one intense frost storm back there.
I am truly sorry... At that moment, I could not contain the heat boiling up within my heart.
To think that heat would unleash such a powerful storm...
Well, you definitely showed me what you're capable of.
I have no excuse...
I brought you to this bathhouse in haste to treat you, Fixer.
You're the one who brought me here?
The Fit Angels brought you here, Fixer.
They helped right after sparring with me, so I am deeply grateful to them.
I only lost consciousness for a moment... I seem to be perfectly fine.
Not at all. Wounds often form where the eyes cannot see.
I believed that this bath, made <bouten>exclusively for me</bouten>, was absolutely necessary for your complete recovery.
Ah, so that's why it was so incredibly hot...
Since this temperature is suited to me, it is likely far too hot for you, Fixer.
But there is no need to worry.
I shall adjust the temperature for you.
True. If it's you, you could easily cool down water this hot.
Thank you for your permission. In that case, I shall prepare immediately.
We're going in together?
Is there some kind of problem?
No, it's just better than I could have ever hoped for.
Then I shall adjust it to a suitable temperature.
Fixer, please... I must ask you to <bouten>undress</bouten> as well.
Uh, sure.
We silently undressed. Only the rustling of clothes filled the quiet bathhouse.
Then, I shall enter first to adjust the temperature.
